scope: Existing unittest suite with synthetic reports, real temporary SQLite databases, FakeSMTP submission boundaries and offline CLI subprocesses using explicit temporary database arguments.

Idempotent identical preparation, conflicts on changed envelope or content, and input validation

Accepted, recognized rejected, ambiguous and interrupted outcomes

Claim and outcome write/commit failures, immutable identities and replay blocking

failure_history.current_run: All 25 selected tests completed successfully. No behavioral red run is claimed.
failure_history.historical_receipt_gap: Bounded recovery did not locate independently inspectable output for an earlier reported 25-test focused and 100-test full-host run. A relinquished lane recorded no execution; an older 68-test receipt does not substitute for the 100-test run.

historical_full_host_result.qualification: The completed 25-test run above is new focused evidence, not reconstruction or independent verification of the historical full-host claim.

limitations: Passing the synthetic suite establishes the covered tracker behavior at these file hashes, not production database integrity or live authentication, submission, delivery or reading.
SMTP is substituted. Caller-supplied transports must obey the documented smtplib contract; real server behavior was not tested.
The documented path is one recipient with frozen plain-text content. Attachments and cross-tool or cross-database deduplication are not supported by this verification.
No reader application, Android device, helper setup or mailbox operation was executed by this run or this packaging step.
File hashes bind working inputs; this record does not establish a published Git revision. Relevant changed inputs require reassessment rather than reuse as current evidence.
